//! CoreText capture shim for the pre-fontdue tree (commit 57b76e2a^).
//!
//! This file is NOT part of the eseq-linux branch. It exists only so the
//! eseq-linux.23 harness can produce the `coretext-macos-*` reference set from
//! the historical tree, and it deliberately drives the production CoreText
//! atlas rather than reimplementing rasterization:
//!
//! * metrics come from the same `CTFont` calls `GlyphAtlas`/`SizedFontCache`
//!   make (the CoreText atlas keeps `descent`/`leading` private, and monospace
//!   has no per-character advance accessor),
//! * glyph coverage is read back out of the atlas' `MTLTexture`, which is the
//!   only copy of the rasterized pixels at this commit.

use std::ffi::CString;
use std::ptr::NonNull;

use objc2::rc::Retained;
use objc2::runtime::ProtocolObject;
use objc2_core_foundation::{CFRetained, CFString, CGSize};
use objc2_core_text::{CTFont, CTFontOrientation, CTFontUIFontType};
use objc2_metal::{
    MTLCreateSystemDefaultDevice, MTLDevice, MTLOrigin, MTLRegion, MTLSize, MTLTexture,
};

use super::{FontMeasurement, GlyphRaster, MONOSPACE_FONT_NAME, TextCaptureSource};
use crate::glyph_atlas::{GlyphAtlas, ProportionalGlyphAtlas, SizedFontCache};

const MONO_ATLAS_SIZE: usize = 1024;
const PROP_ATLAS_SIZE: usize = 2048;
/// `ProportionalGlyphAtlas::rasterize` draws each glyph two pixels into its
/// bitmap so antialiasing has room; the pen therefore sits two pixels right of
/// the bitmap's left edge.
const PROP_GLYPH_PADDING_X: f32 = 2.0;
/// A base size whose tenths key (10) cannot collide with any captured
/// proportional size, so `SizedFontCache` never hands back the unscaled
/// metrics it caches for its base font.
const BASE_FONT_SIZE: f64 = 1.0;
// kCFStringEncodingUTF8
const CF_UTF8: u32 = 0x0800_0100;

pub struct PlatformTextCaptureSource;

impl PlatformTextCaptureSource {
    fn device() -> Result<Retained<ProtocolObject<dyn MTLDevice>>, String> {
        MTLCreateSystemDefaultDevice().ok_or_else(|| "no Metal device".to_string())
    }

    fn mono_atlas(font_size: f32, scale_factor: f32) -> Result<GlyphAtlas, String> {
        let device = Self::device()?;
        GlyphAtlas::new(&device, MONOSPACE_FONT_NAME, f64::from(font_size * scale_factor))
            .ok_or_else(|| "could not load a monospace font".to_string())
    }

    fn proportional_atlas(scale_factor: f32) -> Result<ProportionalGlyphAtlas, String> {
        let device = Self::device()?;
        ProportionalGlyphAtlas::new(&device, BASE_FONT_SIZE, f64::from(scale_factor))
            .ok_or_else(|| "could not load the system UI font".to_string())
    }

    fn mono_font(font_size: f32, scale_factor: f32) -> Result<CFRetained<CTFont>, String> {
        let name = {
            let cstr = CString::new(MONOSPACE_FONT_NAME).map_err(|error| error.to_string())?;
            unsafe { CFString::with_c_string(None, cstr.as_ptr(), CF_UTF8) }
                .ok_or_else(|| "could not build a CFString font name".to_string())?
        };
        Ok(unsafe {
            CTFont::with_name(
                &name,
                f64::from(font_size * scale_factor),
                std::ptr::null(),
            )
        })
    }

    fn ui_font(font_size: f32, scale_factor: f32) -> Result<CFRetained<CTFont>, String> {
        unsafe {
            CTFont::new_ui_font_for_language(
                CTFontUIFontType::System,
                f64::from(font_size * scale_factor),
                None,
            )
        }
        .ok_or_else(|| "could not load the system UI font".to_string())
    }
}

impl TextCaptureSource for PlatformTextCaptureSource {
    fn backend_name(&self) -> &'static str {
        "coretext"
    }

    fn mono_font_name(&self) -> Result<String, String> {
        let font = Self::mono_font(16.0, 1.0)?;
        Ok(unsafe { font.post_script_name() }.to_string())
    }

    fn proportional_font_name(&self) -> Result<String, String> {
        let font = Self::ui_font(BASE_FONT_SIZE as f32, 1.0)?;
        Ok(unsafe { font.post_script_name() }.to_string())
    }

    fn measure_mono(
        &self,
        font_size: f32,
        scale_factor: f32,
        charset: &str,
    ) -> Result<FontMeasurement, String> {
        let atlas = Self::mono_atlas(font_size, scale_factor)?;
        let font = Self::mono_font(font_size, scale_factor)?;
        Ok(FontMeasurement {
            cell_w: atlas.cell_w as f32,
            cell_h: atlas.cell_h as f32,
            ascent: unsafe { font.ascent() } as f32,
            descent: unsafe { font.descent() } as f32,
            leading: unsafe { font.leading() } as f32,
            advance_widths: charset
                .chars()
                .map(|ch| (ch, char_advance(&font, ch)))
                .collect(),
        })
    }

    fn measure_proportional(
        &self,
        font_size: f32,
        scale_factor: f32,
        charset: &str,
    ) -> Result<FontMeasurement, String> {
        let mut fonts = SizedFontCache::new(BASE_FONT_SIZE, f64::from(scale_factor))
            .ok_or_else(|| "could not load the system UI font".to_string())?;
        let size_tenths = size_tenths(font_size)?;
        let font = Self::ui_font(font_size, scale_factor)?;
        Ok(FontMeasurement {
            cell_w: fonts.char_advance('m', size_tenths),
            cell_h: fonts.line_height(size_tenths),
            ascent: fonts.ascent(size_tenths),
            descent: fonts.descent(size_tenths),
            leading: unsafe { font.leading() } as f32,
            advance_widths: charset
                .chars()
                .map(|ch| (ch, fonts.char_advance(ch, size_tenths)))
                .collect(),
        })
    }

    fn rasterize_mono_text(
        &self,
        text: &str,
        font_size: f32,
        scale_factor: f32,
    ) -> Result<Vec<GlyphRaster>, String> {
        let mut atlas = Self::mono_atlas(font_size, scale_factor)?;
        let mut entries = Vec::with_capacity(text.chars().count());
        for ch in text.chars() {
            let entry = *atlas
                .get_or_rasterize(ch)
                .ok_or_else(|| format!("could not rasterize {ch:?}"))?;
            entries.push(entry);
        }
        let (cell_w, cell_h) = (atlas.cell_w, atlas.cell_h);
        entries
            .into_iter()
            .map(|entry| {
                read_back(
                    &atlas.texture,
                    MONO_ATLAS_SIZE,
                    entry.uv_min,
                    cell_w,
                    cell_h,
                    0.0,
                    cell_w as f32,
                )
            })
            .collect()
    }

    fn rasterize_proportional_text(
        &self,
        text: &str,
        font_size: f32,
        scale_factor: f32,
    ) -> Result<Vec<GlyphRaster>, String> {
        let mut atlas = Self::proportional_atlas(scale_factor)?;
        let size_tenths = size_tenths(font_size)?;
        let mut entries = Vec::with_capacity(text.chars().count());
        for ch in text.chars() {
            entries.push(
                *atlas
                    .get_or_rasterize(ch, size_tenths)
                    .ok_or_else(|| format!("could not rasterize {ch:?}"))?,
            );
        }
        entries
            .into_iter()
            .map(|entry| {
                read_back(
                    &atlas.texture,
                    PROP_ATLAS_SIZE,
                    entry.uv_min,
                    entry.raster_w,
                    entry.raster_h,
                    -PROP_GLYPH_PADDING_X,
                    entry.advance,
                )
            })
            .collect()
    }
}

fn size_tenths(font_size: f32) -> Result<u16, String> {
    if !font_size.is_finite() || font_size <= 0.0 || font_size > u16::MAX as f32 / 10.0 {
        return Err(format!("invalid font size {font_size}"));
    }
    Ok((font_size * 10.0).round() as u16)
}

fn char_advance(font: &CTFont, ch: char) -> f32 {
    if ch as u32 > 0xFFFF {
        return 0.0;
    }
    let chars: [u16; 1] = [ch as u16];
    let mut glyph = [0u16; 1];
    unsafe {
        font.glyphs_for_characters(
            NonNull::new(chars.as_ptr() as *mut _).unwrap(),
            NonNull::new(glyph.as_mut_ptr()).unwrap(),
            1,
        );
    }
    let mut advance = CGSize {
        width: 0.0,
        height: 0.0,
    };
    unsafe {
        font.advances_for_glyphs(
            CTFontOrientation::Default,
            NonNull::new(glyph.as_mut_ptr()).unwrap(),
            &mut advance,
            1,
        );
    }
    advance.width as f32
}

/// Read one glyph's coverage back out of the atlas texture. The bitmap context
/// CoreText drew into is already stored top-down (the renderer's `v = 1.0 - v`
/// flip is a Metal UV-origin convention, not a row-order fix), so the readback
/// matches the schema's row order as-is.
fn read_back(
    texture: &ProtocolObject<dyn MTLTexture>,
    atlas_size: usize,
    uv_min: [f32; 2],
    width: usize,
    height: usize,
    offset_x: f32,
    advance: f32,
) -> Result<GlyphRaster, String> {
    if width == 0 || height == 0 {
        return Ok(GlyphRaster {
            width,
            height,
            offset_x,
            advance,
            pixels: Vec::new(),
        });
    }
    let x = (uv_min[0] * atlas_size as f32).round() as usize;
    let y = (uv_min[1] * atlas_size as f32).round() as usize;
    let mut pixels = vec![0u8; width * height];
    unsafe {
        texture.getBytes_bytesPerRow_fromRegion_mipmapLevel(
            NonNull::new(pixels.as_mut_ptr() as *mut core::ffi::c_void).unwrap(),
            width,
            MTLRegion {
                origin: MTLOrigin { x, y, z: 0 },
                size: MTLSize {
                    width,
                    height,
                    depth: 1,
                },
            },
            0,
        );
    }
    Ok(GlyphRaster {
        width,
        height,
        offset_x,
        advance,
        pixels,
    })
}
